Hello.
Xingtian is a major corporation now, and senior personnel changes are sensitive in the public eye.

words.gram: Meaning: as far as ... is concerned.

lines.trans: According to the official line given to our PR department, you are not a company vice president.
So please keep your messaging strictly aligned with PR, or this could easily cause misunderstandings.
Xingtian prizes its public image above all; if Mr Xie speaks carelessly outside and sparks a PR incident, you will be held accountable.
Besides, although our chairwoman is a woman, she is even more decisive and ruthless than any man.
Under company rules, the most serious public-relations violations carry immediate dismissal.
Do not say I failed to warn you in advance today.
Remind me what your name was again?
With someone of my stature, why would I stoop to your level?
We have plenty of days ahead to settle scores!
